proves.claim: clause 1: waitedOnItems returns, for each child item an open parent item names as childHandle#id, the sorted parent item ids that wait on it.

store.io-board-link-waiting.lists-waitin.why: Without it a child board could miss, double-count or wrongly list the parent items that wait on it.

proves.claim: clause 2: a verified or withdrawn parent item, a local dependency and a foreign dependency on another handle are not counted.

store.io-board-link-waiting.skips-done-l.why: Without it a child board could miss, double-count or wrongly list the parent items that wait on it.

proves.claim: clause 3: a parent item naming childHandle#7 twice, or two parent items naming it, give one entry for 7 with each parent id once.

store.io-board-link-waiting.one-entry-ea.why: Without it a child board could miss, double-count or wrongly list the parent items that wait on it.
